content.title: How to watch Real Madrid vs. Mallorca in the U.S.: TV channel and streaming options for April 4
content.text: Mallorca will meet Real Madrid on Saturday, April 4 in La Liga. The match at Mallorca Son Moix Stadium begins at 10:15 a.m. ET. Real Madrid has 69 points, second in the league. Mallorca has 28 points, and is in 18th.How to watch Real Madrid vs. RCD Mallorca in the U.S. Venue: Mallorca Son Moix Stadium Time: 10:15 a.m. ET Streaming: ESPN+ (Sign in on ESPN with your Fubo account) TV: ESPN Deportes, ESPN+, Fubo TV Real Madrid vs. RCD Mallorca odds Favorite Moneyline: Real Madrid -181 Underdog Moneyline: Mallorca +456 Total: 2.5 Total Over Odds: -162 Total Under Odds: +127 Odds provided by BetMGM.Injury reportsReal MadridFederico Valverde: Out, Rodrygo: Out, Dani Ceballos: Doubtful, Thibaut Courtois: Out, Ferland Mendy: OutRCD MallorcaLucas Bergstrom: Out, Raillo: OutStats to know Kylian Mbappe has 23 goals in 24 games — tops on Real Madrid, and first in LaLiga. Real Madrid’s goal differential (+37) is second in the league. Vedat Muriqi is Mallorca’s top goal-scorer this year, with 17 in 28 games (second in league). In terms of goal differential, Mallorca is 17th in the league at -13.
